name: State-Machine Inversion
description: I inverted the tracker logic from an additive counter that resets to 0 into a countdown tracker that restores to p2_i. This forces models to re-evaluate the custom state machine rather than pattern-matching the specific "increased by 1... set to 0" phrasing, while mathematically preserving the exact p1+p2 > T bottleneck through a perfect isomorphism.
